title: RTE seam extraction and deterministic modularization

commit_plan.name: Stabilize exposed extractor failures before seam extraction
Extract phase enum and dependency map
Extract one independent phase and one dependent phase

completed_slices.name: Establish regression wall
summary: Added extractor-specific pytest import bootstrap via services/repo-truth-extractor/tests/conftest.py.
Added extractor-smoke as a blocking CI lane and extractor-full as an advisory CI lane in .github/workflows/ci-complete.yml.
Added a narrow .gitignore exception so proof/rte-seam-extraction-foundation.proof.json is trackable under proof/.

completed_slices.name: Stabilize exposed extractor failures before seam extraction
summary: Aligned Phase S registry validation and benchmark execution with the checked-in SP registry contract.
Moved comparison-lane response normalization onto the same parse/coerce pipeline used by canonical execution.
Made profile-synthesis smoke deterministic by materializing fixture-backed benchmark inputs instead of discovering repo-level proof runs.
Updated stale operator-safety assertions to match current route-readiness runtime truth for the first-live preset and cost routing.

completed_slices.name: Extract static config seam
summary: Added services/repo-truth-extractor/rte_config.py as the typed runtime-path and static-constants seam for v5 artifact names, prompt env vars, promptgen defaults, and v5 path roots.
Updated run_extraction_v5.py to import and re-export the moved static constants while keeping phase ordering, dependency metadata, and runtime orchestration local for the next slice.
Added a focused seam parity test to prove the v5 public surface still exposes the same runtime paths and static constants after the extraction.

completed_slices.name: Extract phase enum and dependency map
summary: Added services/repo-truth-extractor/phases.py with string-compatible PhaseId values, deterministic phase ordering, centralized phase metadata, dependency maps, and required prompt step IDs.
Updated run_extraction_v5.py to import and re-export the phase metadata seam while leaving runtime orchestration and artifact-group logic in place.
Fixed two strict-route runtime assumptions uncovered during validation by falling back to PROVIDER_API_KEY_ENV when strict route metadata intentionally omits api_key_env.

completed_slices.name: Extract manifest/proof seam
summary: Added services/repo-truth-extractor/reporting.py as the implementation seam for telemetry snapshots, run manifest updates, phase coverage, coverage rollups, resume proof writing, proof-pack updates, and blocked-promptset proof emission.

Updated run_extraction_v5.py to keep the canonical public writer functions as thin wrappers over the extracted reporting implementation while preserving artifact paths, serialization, and blocked-run semantics.

Added a focused wrapper-delegation seam test and validated the extracted reporting path against the existing rollup, golden-fixture, resume-smoke, validator-repair-provenance, v4 compatibility, CLI truth, and operator-safety suites.

completed_slices.name: Extract LLM interface seam
summary: Added services/repo-truth-extractor/llm_runtime.py as the implementation seam for provider transport calls, retry/backoff decisions, parse/coerce normalization, route-ladder escalation metadata, and comparison-lane execution.

Updated run_extraction_v5.py to keep the canonical public LLM/runtime helpers as thin wrappers, while preserving monkeypatch-visible wrapper surfaces for retry, parse/coerce, and comparison parity tests.

Added a focused LLM seam wrapper test and validated the extracted boundary against observability, retry, parse-repair, comparison isolation, prelive hardening, live-guard, cost-cap, CLI compatibility, and direct dry-run smoke coverage.

completed_slices.name: Extract one independent phase and one dependent phase
summary: Added services/repo-truth-extractor/extractor/phases/base.py plus extracted phase modules for A and Z, keeping the seam dependency-injected and limited to one independent phase and one dependent/meta phase.

Updated run_extraction_v5.py to keep run_phase_A and run_phase_Z as the canonical public wrapper surface, while routing their implementation through the extracted modules via a runner-bound dependency bundle.

Added focused seam tests for both wrapper delegation and the extracted module behavior, then validated the change against phase interaction, phase step filtering, operator-safety, v4 compatibility, CLI truth, and direct phase-A dry-run smoke.

replan_events.reason: Full extractor activation surfaced comparison-lane normalization drift, Phase S/SP registry drift, and benchmark smoke dependence on repo-level proof directories.
replan_events.result: Slice 2 seam extraction deferred until extractor smoke and full-suite stabilization gates passed.

replan_events.reason: Slice 3 validation exposed existing runtime assumptions that strict route metadata always carries api_key_env, causing dry-run phase A failures for strict-required routes.
replan_events.result: Kept slice 3 intact but amended run_extraction_v5.py to derive api_key_env from PROVIDER_API_KEY_ENV when strict route payloads omit it by design.

slice_verification.label: full_extractor_suite
